Title: Backend Engineer
Company: Northstar Labs
Required skills: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
Preferred skills: Redis, Docker
Responsibilities: Build and maintain REST APIs
Education requirement: Bachelor degree
Experience requirement: 2 years backend development
Keywords: API, reliability

Title: Data Engineer
Company: River Analytics
Must-have skills: Python, SQL, Airflow
Nice-to-have skills: dbt, Spark
Responsibilities: Build reliable batch data pipelines
Experience requirement: 3 years data engineering
Keywords: ETL, data quality

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Company: Cedar AI
Mandatory skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn
Bonus skills: MLflow, Kubernetes
Responsibilities: Train and deploy classification models
Education requirement: Master degree
Keywords: model serving, evaluation

Title: Frontend Engineer
Company: Harbor Commerce
Required skills: TypeScript, React, CSS
Preferred skills: Next.js, Playwright
Responsibilities: Develop accessible customer interfaces
Experience requirement: 2 years frontend development
Keywords: accessibility, performance

Title: Platform Engineer
Company: Summit Cloud
Necessary skills: Linux, Terraform, Kubernetes
A plus: Go, Prometheus
Responsibilities: Operate the internal deployment platform
Experience requirement: 4 years platform engineering
Keywords: infrastructure, observability

Title: QA Automation Engineer
Company: Maple Systems
Required skills: Python, pytest, Selenium
Preferred skills: Playwright, Jenkins
Responsibilities: Design automated regression suites
Experience requirement: 2 years test automation
Keywords: quality, regression

Title: Android Engineer
Company: Metro Mobility
Must-have skills: Kotlin, Android SDK, Jetpack Compose
Nice-to-have skills: Firebase, Gradle
Responsibilities: Build passenger mobile features
Experience requirement: 3 years Android development
Keywords: mobile, usability

Title: Security Analyst
Company: Oak Finance
Mandatory skills: SIEM, incident response, Python
Preferred skills: Splunk, cloud security
Responsibilities: Investigate security alerts
Experience requirement: 2 years security operations
Keywords: SOC, threat detection

Title: Product Data Analyst
Company: Bright Market
Required skills: SQL, Python, dashboarding
Preferred skills: Looker, experimentation
Responsibilities: Analyze product adoption and retention
Education requirement: Bachelor degree
Keywords: metrics, insights
Team tools include GitHub and Slack

Title: AI Agent Engineer
Company: Pine Research
Required skills: Python, LangGraph, RAG
Preferred skills: FastAPI, vector databases
Responsibilities: Build evidence-grounded assistant workflows
Experience requirement: 2 years applied AI development
Keywords: agents, retrieval
The team is exploring Rust
